Bill.BriefDescription: Providing funds to enforce the tobacco sampling statutes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tobacco sampling; and adding a new section tochapter 82.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A tax is imposed on persons engaged in the business ofsampling. The tax shall equal one dollar per sample distributed by thesampler. (2) The sampler shall maintain records regarding the number oftobacco samples distributed to members of the general public. (3) The department may adopt rules necessary to administer thissection. (4) The administrative provisions of chapter 82.32 RCW apply tothis section. (5) The terms "sampler" and "sampling" have the meaning provided inRCW 70.155.010. (6) The tobacco sampling enforcement account is created in thecustody of the state treasurer. All receipts from the tax imposed inthis section must be deposited into the account. Expenditures from the p. 1 SB 6330account may be used only for the enforcement of the tax provisions ofthis section and the enforcement of the sampling provisions of chapter70.155 RCW. The department of revenue shall only retain the necessaryproceeds to administer the tax provisions of this section and remit allremaining proceeds to the liquor control board for the enforcement ofthe sampling provisions of chapter 70.155 RCW. Only the director of the department of revenue or the director's designee may authorizeexpenditures from the account. The account is subject to allotmentprocedures under chapter 43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is notrequired for expenditures.
